description: This file declares the interface for the OcdmSystem class and its factory, which are responsible for managing OpenCDM system operations such as retrieving version info, session limits, and hashes, as well as creating sessions. It includes external dependencies related to OpenCDM and defines classes within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace.

classes.name: OcdmSystemFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IOcdmSystem, implementing the createOcdmSystem method.

classes.name: OcdmSystem
classes.description: Implementation of the IOcdmSystem interface, managing OpenCDM system operations and holding a system handle.

methods.name: createOcdmSystem
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IOcdmSystem instance based on the provided key system string.

methods.name: OcdmSystem (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes an OcdmSystem instance with the specified key system.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of the DRM system.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the limit for LDL sessions.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getSecureStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the secure store.

methods.name: getDrmTime
methods.description: Gets the current DRM system time.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with the specified client.
